# Falcon-7 Design Review: Thermal and Power

**Date:** March 12, 2025
**Attendees:** Priya Patel (Design Lead), Amanda Foster, James Kim, Rachel Adams

Priya Patel: The Falcon-7 power domain redesign reduces leakage by 18 percent at 150C junction temperature.
James Kim: Our test coverage for the new low-power mode is only at 74 percent. We need more vectors before tape-out.
Amanda Foster: Tape-out stays on April 15. We cannot slip, the AEC-Q100 qualification window depends on it.
Rachel Adams: The lead customer asked for samples in Q3, so the schedule is tight.

Decision: Keep the April 15 tape-out date and add a dedicated test vector sprint.

Action items:
- James Kim to raise low-power mode coverage to 90 percent by April 1.
- Priya Patel to publish the updated thermal model by March 20.
